methodologyNotes: Each vendor's official pricing page was re-fetched via WebFetch on 2026-06-18 (accuranker.com/pricing, nightwatch.io/pricing/, seranking.com/pricing.html + seranking.com/subscription.html, wincher.com/pricing + help.wincher.com, mangools.com/plans-and-pricing, advancedwebranking.com/pricing/, serpstat.com/page/pricing-plans/, proranktracker.com/plans_and_pricing). Rule applied: a null beats a guess; monthlyUsd is only populated when the OFFICIAL page bills in USD. SE Ranking's official page (subscription.html and pricing.html) displays EUR (Core €109/mo, Growth €235/mo); the third-party $129/$279 figures conflict with the official billing currency, so monthlyUsd was set to null and the official EUR prices are recorded in notes. Nightwatch and Wincher likewise publish EUR-only pricing -> monthlyUsd null. Mangools' official page is JS-rendered and would not return prices; monthly USD $49/$69/$129 is corroborated by two independent sources (webmetools.com, ecommerceparadise.com) but annual-billing figures conflict across sources, so annualDiscountPct was nulled. AWR free trial corrected to 30 days; Serpstat trial set to 7 days. Rank Ranger excluded (domain redirects to SimilarWeb post-acquisition). billingModel is flat for self-serve tiers, custom for contact-sales tiers. accessedAt 2026-06-18.
